firstScreen.notes: 1440-first.jpg: h1 'A quarter inch every ten feet.' has no trade and no place, only the eyebrow does (-1.0). Phone in header+hero, one primary + outlined secondary, Sample proof line, pitch ruler visible, next band peeks ~70px. Diagonal split edge does not meet the photo's gutter as the concept claims. 390-first.jpg: h1 2 lines, Call above fold, proof line below fold.

distinctiveness.notes: Pitch Run in hero, margin readout, services hangers, story, size-check fall sketch, downspout drops, break photo, review ft stamps, price troughs, footer downspout (1440-rm-full.jpg, 1440-scroll-25/75.jpg). Siblings B/C differ fully. Cream + terracotta palette tell (-0.5); mono micro-labels and middle-dot meta strings everywhere (-0.5).

type.notes: Aleo/Public Sans + listed mono accent, strong h1 scale contrast, real fraction glyphs, en-dash hours (1440-rm-full.jpg). Service card body ~15px mid-grey (-0.5); straight apostrophe in 'Darnell's' (1440-scroll-75.jpg, -0.5).

layout.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg: tones alternate cleanly, full-bleed break, dense reviews with a wide lead quote, 64px readout margin column. 'h2 left, grey lede right' repeated in services, tools, area; tools lede floats low (1440-scroll-50.jpg, -0.5). Story pin ~3900px for one screen of content (1440-full.jpg).

photo.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg: two on-topic frames only. Hero cool desaturated vs break saturated blue sky/warm brick (mixed grade -0.5); break frame soft/upscaled and shows front door + mailbox straight on.

copy.notes: Real trade nouns (sweetgum balls, loess soil, chalk on the fascia), honest ranges, microcopy under form (1440-rm-full.jpg). Primary action named 'Price my run' / 'Price it' / 'Put this on my quote' / 'Quote' (1440-first.jpg, 390-first.jpg, -0.5). Proof line 'Germantown and nearby' for a Memphis business (1440-first.jpg).

mobile.notes: 390-first.jpg: hero re-cut, h1 2 lines, sticky bar works; render.json no overflow at 320/390; story stacked, not pinned (390-full.jpg). 8 full service cards stacked ~2000px with no phone density decision; footer nav links under 48px (390-full.jpg, -0.5).

a11y.notes: Skip link, 3px signal focus with 3px offset, forced-colors, labels on inputs; reduced motion shows everything (1440-rm-full.jpg, 390-rm-full.jpg). mustFix: inactive story steps ~2.5-3:1 on #241A12 (1440-scroll-25.jpg); capped at 8.0.

motion.notes: 1440-scroll-25/50/75.jpg: margin readout counts fall in 1/4 in steps, pinned story with rolling drop, line-split headings, tree tabs, footer downspout. The run in the story is nearly flat so the 'falling pitch' idea barely reads; data-split on all 10 headings in dist/index.html.

wow.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg (tools): size check draws the fall over the typed run ('A 40 ft run hung at 1/4 in per 10 ft falls 1 in.') with a trough sketch; downspout count draws drops on the run; tree sorter answers what to fit. Tied to thesis and trade. Outputs are small and quiet (1440-scroll-50.jpg), so not a 10.

polish.notes: SVG favicon + apple-touch, OG 1200x630, print CSS, forced colors, one rule weight, designed footer (1440-rm-full.jpg). Pill Sample tags vs square buttons/cards (1440-first.jpg, -0.5); bare paper strip under the footer at 390 (390-full.jpg).

mustFix.problem: Titles and body text of the steps not yet reached are dimmed to roughly 2.5-3:1 on #241A12, under 4.5:1 for body text
mustFix.fix: Keep inactive step text at least rgba(247,242,232,.72) on #241A12 (>= 4.5:1); show the not-yet-reached state with the icon and tick colour, not by dimming the text

elevate.move: Make the hero's diagonal the gutter run itself: slant the photo edge at the copper ruler's pitch so the line runs along the seam into the real gutter and outlet in the photo, with the drop rolling down it; the h1 then names Memphis gutters so the first screen states trade, place and thesis in one picture

Art-direct the stock as one sequence along the run: one shared palette grade on every frame, a third close-detail frame (hanger or outlet), and a clip reveal on the break photo that follows the run as it falls across the house, with the ft ticks landing on the real gutter and downspouts
